description.short: Plan, run, and report on events from inside Teams.
description.full: EventBuddy manages the full event lifecycle in Microsoft Teams: create an event and its channel, focus on an event, remind members, list tasks, brainstorm, and generate post-event reports. Talk to it in a 1:1 chat or add it to an event channel.

commands.title: create event
commands.description: Create a new event and its Teams channel

commands.title: focus
commands.description: Focus on an event so following messages apply to it

commands.title: remind
commands.description: Remind members about a task or deadline

commands.title: list tasks
commands.description: List the tasks for the focused event

commands.title: report
commands.description: Generate a report for the focused event
